frontmatter.author: Paul Serban
frontmatter.title: Bootstrap for Website Prototype
frontmatter.subheading: The Key to Streamlining Website Prototype Development
frontmatter.excerpt: Bootstrap is one of the most widely used front-end frameworks for website prototyping. This article takes a brutally honest look at when Bootstrap truly accelerates prototype development, where it falls short, and how to use it effectively to validate ideas fast without sacrificing long-term maintainability.
